episode.title: The Universe's Saddest Goodbye: Solar ECLIPSES

synopsis: As the Moon slowly moves farther from Earth each year, total solar eclipses will eventually cease to exist.
narration: The Moon drifts nearly four centimeters away from Earth every single year. As it steadily recedes into deep space, its apparent disk shrinks, ensuring that total solar eclipses will eventually disappear forever, leaving only partial shadows across our planet.

shots.prompt: A breathtaking total solar eclipse seen from space, the dark silhouetted Moon perfectly covering the brilliant white solar corona with shimmering diamond ring glare.
Camera tracks backward in time-lapse motion as the Moon slowly pulls away from Earth, shrinking in visible size relative to the giant glaring disk of the distant Sun.
An annular eclipse far in the future where a ring of harsh sunlight completely surrounds the smaller Moon, camera seamlessly panning back toward the dark orbital trajectory of shot one.

music: Poignant cosmic strings layered over a soft low synth heartbeat pulse, swelling majestically with bright symphonic textures as solar light breaks through the glowing lunar corona, lingering in solemn emotional resonance before abruptly stopping mid-bar to loop perfectly back to the beginning.
